entry.title: Rolls-Royce I Behind The Scenes: Diving into Rock ‘n’ Roll Legend

media:group.media:title: Rolls-Royce I Behind The Scenes: Diving into Rock ‘n’ Roll Legend
media:group.media:description:
A celebration of Phantom's enduring connection to the world of music, Rolls-Royce brings rock ‘n’ roll legend to life – reimagining an iconic moment in its century of history.
At Plymouth’s celebrated Tinside Lido – an Art Deco landmark tied to both The Beatles and Britain’s seaside heritage – a Phantom Extended bodyshell was carefully craned into the water, creating an image that unites cultural history, architectural beauty and an icon of modern music.
This film takes you behind-the-scenes of this extraordinary moment, a spectacular tribute to 100 years of music, myth, Art Deco elegance and Rolls-Royce craftsmanship.
